New York: September's jewelry sales just split the trade.

Specialty jewelers' revenue rose 5.7% year over year in September, Tenoris data shows, up 8.5% year to date. Growth sits above $2,500: lower-priced unit sales fell 11% while average spend per item rose 11% year over year. Lab-grown-set demand jumped nearly 26% year over year, yet loose lab-grown revenue fell a fifth straight month.
